policy: A font family may be commercially eligible while its shipped binary remains unapproved. Production requires exact artifact evidence and typography quality evidence.
hardGates: exact shipped font file SHA256 recorded
required glyph coverage verified for every assigned locale
browser and final-render typography QA pass
no uncontrolled system-font fallback in supported locales

portfolioLimits.principle: Do not ship a font collection. Ship a coherent CardeLume type system.
